documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. The company posted a 16% growth in revenue and maintained a robust EBITDA margin of 29% along with a 15% PAT margin. Management highlighted significant infrastructure expansions, the adoption of advanced medical technologies including AI-powered systems, and ongoing academic initiatives through its medical college and institute of health sciences. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for the year 2024-25, achieving operating income of ₹1,37,111.30 lakhs and profit after tax of ₹20,894.62 lakhs, alongside a board-recommended 100% dividend. Management highlighted ongoing expansion plans, including adding 100 beds in the main campus and establishing a new 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai with the OP block ready by the year end.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that global healthcare demand continues to rise, driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated the new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block representing a capital investment of Rs 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital launched Tamil Nadu's first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system as part of a Rs 47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the hospital will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital. We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported a significant investment of ₹496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounted to ₹3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added a further 5 MW solar power plant to expand its capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

margins_costs.claim: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and has shown a sustained PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that the profit margin for the year was 15%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March 2024 was 5286.
orders_capacity.quote: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March 2024 was 5286.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the Board has recommended a 100% dividend.
Management stated that the total dividend on equity shares, if approved by members, would involve a cash outflow of ₹1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹10 per share (100%) for the Financial Year 2023-24 for approval of the members.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100%) for the Financial Year 2023-24 for approval of the members.

risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.
